clauses.text:
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and statutes of 
the United States of America, including the Federal Advisory Committee Act, 
as amended (5 U.S.C. App. I), and in order to revise the name of a presidential 
advisory commission to better describe its areas of responsibility, and to 
extend the date within which the commission must complete its responsibil­
ities, it is hereby ordered that Executive Order No. 12503 is amended as 
follows:
The title of the Order and Section 1(a) are amended by deleting “Presidential 
Commission on Outdoor Recreation Resources Review” and inserting in lieu 
thereof “President’s Commission on Americans Outdoors”; and
Section 4(b) of the Order is revised to provide as follows:
“The Commission shall submit its report no later than December 31,1986, and 
shall terminate 30 days after its report.”.

Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees
